title: Process Flow
raw_text:
9/29/26, 10:19 AM

Disconnections and reconnections are managed in disconnection documents . These log the progress of the individual business
transactions.

The system provides functions that you can use in the workflows created for process control. These functions exist as methods of
the DISCONNECT business object (utility disconnection).

SAP IS-U provides you with reference workflows for all disconnection reasons. You can use them as examples and templates for
your own workflows.

Process Flow

The process flow is usually as follows:

Disconnection reason occurs

Overview of disconnection reasons

Disconnection reason                               Triggering type                                        Triggered by

Disconnection dunning level reached in          Automatic                                               Dunning run
accounts receivable and payable

Vacant status                                                Automatic                                                    Move-out without move-in
Customer request                                          Manual                                                         Front office, for example
Technical causes                                       Manual                                                   Front office, for example

Create disconnection document

During creation of a disconnection document, you determine the processing variant based on the disconnection reason and the
reference object of the disconnection document. Some of the basic settings are stored in this processing variant. You can influence
this process by means of a user exit.

If the account receivable and payable is blocked, a disconnection document is automatically created for each account containing
items that have reached the disconnection level.

Release disconnection document

The disconnection document must have been released in order to carry out the next steps. This procedure is useful if you do not

want all of the disconnection documents to immediately lead to disconnection. This is the case, if, for example, you only want to
carry out 100 disconnections per day from a pool of 2500 possible disconnections.

The individual disconnection documents are released during document processing.
You can activate or deactivate the release requirement for disconnection documents in the processing variant for disconnection.

Generate disconnection order

Disconnection orders are generated for released disconnection documents. All of the devices and flat-rate installations that belong
to the reference object of the disconnection document are proposed for disconnection.
